description:
The evil deity has returned at last.
Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame was once a friend who, alongside the great Three Sages, helped bring magic into the world.
But after being consumed by the evil deity "Vahram", he is no longer able to hear the calls from "Endymion" or "Verre".
Determined to stop Zoroa, the sages put up a desperate fight, but are overwhelmed by the immense power of the revived deity.
As the two are pushed to the brink, another old friend appears before them. One whose path parted from theirs long ago.
Source: Official English Website

titles.title: Magistus IV: "Zoroa, the Magistus of Flame"
